summary: Revised implementation plan for the CA Tax & GST Automation Suite addressing all 10 mandatory engineering requirements: strict DEMO vs. REAL mode isolation, strict ExcelJS .xlsx/.csv compatibility and .xls handling, precise zero-loss blank row definition and manifest auditing, AES-256-GCM authenticated vault with PBKDF2/scrypt and independent salts, robust job state machine with server restart recovery and per-client mutex locking, sandbox filesystem security against zip-slip and path traversal, local loopback and Origin/CSRF API protection, and a comprehensive automated test suite.
